ModMetaData.name: GlyphFix
ModMetaData.author: SleepSheep
ModMetaData.description: Repairs six rendering defects of the Waylith Android port: blank build-menu icons (uiIcon resolved to BadTex through an unrenderable CutoutComplexUI material); the empty gizmo box beside Draft (Misc/GrayscaleGUI is not registered in this port, so disabled-command icons were drawn through the default shader); masked DLC art that drew blank or drew its own mask (double-extension content keys broke every mask lookup, and let masks into Graphic_Collection's variant list); items whose own instance graphic has no usable texture (GetIconFor(Thing, ...) is instance level only, so the icon fell back to def.uiIcon, then to the def graphic, with the broken out material dropped); textures whose spelling differs from the def's texPath (IbexMALE_east, Longsword, Bullet_Big - the port's lookup is ordinal, Windows' was not); and loose .dds files that made the loader delete a same-named .png before discovering the .dds cannot be decoded at all (DXT3/DXT2/DXT4/ATI1/ATI2/BC4U/BC5U, a bad header or a short file). The shadow guard reads only the 148-byte DDS header, caches the verdict per path against mtime and length, and leaves the .dds in place whenever it really can be decoded. Steady-state cost 16.7 ns per patched call.
